allocations.referenced_tables_access: read-only; reg.phase1_registry_drivers is the driver identity source, admin.phase1_driver_fleet_affiliations is the active fleet cohort source (same join FleetPartnerService.listPortalDrivers() already performs)

modifies_existing_tables.change: ALTER COLUMN driver_id TYPE varchar(100) USING driver_id::text; DROP CONSTRAINT driver_training_records_driver_id_fkey (to reg.drivers)
ALTER COLUMN driver_id TYPE varchar(100) USING driver_id::text; DROP CONSTRAINT driver_reg_profiles_driver_id_fkey (to reg.drivers); driver_id remains primary key
modifies_existing_tables.access: write (upsert training_status column only, on pass/expiry transitions)

allocations.not_referenced: reg.drivers (uuid PK) has no runtime write path in apps/api/src and must not be used as an identity target or cohort denominator; see driver_identity_decision_ref
allocations.description: 課程、測驗、完訓與重訓資料服務 migration
Host 自車受限 read model 與所有權授權 migration

boundary_invariants.anti_collision_rule: Migrations V0086 through V0093 are exclusively reserved for Unattended Voice Booking (UV-EXEC); SR migrations strictly begin at V0094 and increment sequentially without collision.
boundary_invariants.root_module_wiring_rule: Root app.module.ts wiring is exclusively reserved for SR-WIRE-001; leaf BE tasks only export standalone NestJS modules.
boundary_invariants.interface_consumption_rule: Frontend (FE) and Backend (BE) tasks may only consume interfaces approved and exported by @drts/contracts and @drts/api-client.
boundary_invariants.authoritative_model_rule: No fixture, hardcoded percentages (such as FX_FLEET_TRAINING), dummy signatures, or mock delivery may substitute real authoritative state.
boundary_invariants.financial_policy_hold_rule: Host vehicle commission split and net earnings remain null / pending_policy in Phase 1; downstream SR-HOST-BE-001 must not fabricate pseudo financial algorithms.

amendments.reason: Original allocation referenced reg.drivers (uuid PK, no runtime write path) as a referenced table for driver identity, which blocked SR-ACADEMY-BE-001 implementation (docs/04-uat/system-remediation-20260906/SR-ACADEMY-BE-001.md checkpoint). Corrected to the runtime text driver-id model already used by reg.phase1_registry_drivers, following the V0055 precedent.
